spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Carys Whitlock. Your app was down yesterday, so I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time. I’m really unhappy with the bank—it’s caused me a late-payment charge.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that happened, Carys. I’ll do my best to sort it out. Before I look at your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. I’m sorry the app let you down. The late fee should be refunded, and we’ll get that put right for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’ve already paid the bill today, but the supplier charged me £18 because it was late.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. Could you tell me which supplier it was and when the payment went through?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: North Vale Energy. I paid it at about nine this morning.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right, thanks. I’ll ask our payments team to check what happened with the app and the charge. We’ll get back to you within five working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t think I should have to chase this when your app was the problem.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re right that it shouldn’t have been left to you to sort out. I’ll take ownership: I’ll send the details to our payments team today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm next Wednesday with an update on the £18 charge.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’d like to know what you’re doing about it, not just be told to wait.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. Just to summarise, I’m asking the payments team to review the app issue and your £18 late fee, and I’ll call by 4 pm next Wednesday with an update. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Carys. I’m sorry for the trouble this has caused, and I’ll make sure you hear from me by then.
